title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a screen. Intracranial EEG and the participants' pitch-shifted speech audio were recorded simultaneously from 1103 contacts covering cortical and subcortical structures. Electrode localisations, FreeSurfer derivatives and the source NWB files are included to support research on speech production and speech decoding for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: sEEG was recorded with Dixi Medical Microdeep platinum-iridium shafts and Micromed SD LTM amplifiers, referenced to a common white-matter contact, and downsampled to 1024 Hz. Audio was captured with a notebook microphone at 48 kHz and pitch-shifted for anonymity. Neural, audio and stimulus streams were synchronised with LabStreamingLayer. Electrodes were localised with img_pipe by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT, and labelled using the Destrieux atlas.
